about_the_game:
Most of the in-game content were translated by generative ai, so if you feel it is not appropriate, welcome to contact with me by email or through the community.

A young boy chosen by destiny embarks on a mission to purify the five sacred stones. He traverses treacherous mountains and desolate deserts, facing the unknown and his own fears. Along the journey, while battling dark forces, he uncovers the secrets hidden within the world. Each adventure strengthens his resolve, ultimately leading him to the pivotal moment that will change the fate of the world.

Gameplay Features:

  • Classic ATB (Active Time Battle) Combat System

    Engaging in dynamic battles where time flows continuously. Make real-time strategic decisions.

  • Character Customization

    Personalizing your character’s appearance. Create a hero that reflects your personality and stand out in the world of adventure.

  • Unlimited Skill Learning and Casting

    Learning and cast any skill without restrictions. Experiment with countless skill combinations to create your ultimate playstyle.

  • Recruit Companions

    Feeling lonely on your journey? Head to the Adventurers’ Guild to recruit companions! You can even switch party members depending on the challenges ahead.

  • Customizable Attribute Points

    Gain attribute points as you level up and allocate them freely to enhance your character’s stats.

  • Trial Tower

    Enter the Trial Tower, a specially designed area where adventurers can safely battle monsters to gain experience, gold. Even if you failed in battle, the game will not end instead.

  • Diverse Quests and Hidden Secrets

    A world filled with diverse quests, ranging from epic main storylines to heartfelt side stories. Discover hidden caves, finding the hidden lore or treasures in the game.

pc_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • OS: Windows 10/11 (32bit/64bit)
  • Processor: Intel Core i5 or better
  • Memory: 8 GB RAM
  • Graphics: Compatible OpenGL / VRAM 2GB or better
  • Storage: 800 MB available space
pc_requirements.recommended:
Recommended:
  • OS: Windows 10/11 (32bit/64bit)
  • Processor: Intel Core i5 or better
  • Memory: 16 GB RAM
  • Graphics: Compatible OpenGL / VRAM 4GB or better
  • Storage: 2 GB available space

short_description: A boy chosen by destiny sets out to purify five sacred stones. Facing dark forces and uncovering hidden truths, he journeys through harsh lands, overcoming trials. Each step strengthens him, leading to a final moment where the world's fate hangs in balance.
supported_languages: Traditional Chinese, English, Japanese, Simplified Chinese
